{{Top|leg}}
The '''Platinum Pickaxe''' was a fabled pickaxe fashioned from [[Platinum/Legends|platinum]] that was originally owned by [[Trebold Raynor]], founder of [[Raynor Mining Enterprises]]. It was lost by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]], when current Raynor Mining Enterprises head [[Gan Alno]] hired treasure hunters to search for it on [[Trebold Raynor's homeworld]].<ref name="Platinum Pickaxe">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Platinum Pickaxe}}</ref>
